Step.Name: AM-Mock-Hmac-Compute-Success
Step.Condition: request.verb = "POST" AND proxy.pathsuffix MatchesPath "/scopes/*/keys/*/hmacs:compute" AND request.header.X-Mock-Fail != "true"

Step.Name: AM-Mock-Hmac-Compute-Failure
Step.Condition: request.verb = "POST" AND proxy.pathsuffix MatchesPath "/scopes/*/keys/*/hmacs:compute" AND request.header.X-Mock-Fail = "true"

Step.Name: AM-Mock-Hmac-Verify-Failure
Step.Condition: request.verb = "POST" AND proxy.pathsuffix MatchesPath "/scopes/*/keys/*/hmacs:verify" AND request.header.X-Mock-Fail = "true"

Step.Name: AM-Mock-Rsa-Compute-Success

Step.Name: AM-Mock-Rsa-Compute-Failure
